metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.1 · 1958 · The Fly
metas.description: A scientist has a horrific accident when he tries to use his newly invented teleportation device.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.7 · 1959 · Return of the Fly
metas.description: Philippe Delambre, the now-adult son of "The Fly", does some transportation experimentation of his own.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.1 · 1965 · Curse of the Fly
metas.description: Motorist Martin Delambre attempts to keep evidence of his family's bizarre experiments in teleportation hidden from his wife, who is hiding secrets of her own.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 7.6 · 1986 · The Fly
metas.description: A botched experiment transmutes a man into a monstrous insect.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 5.2 · 1989 · The Fly II
metas.description: The almost-human son of "Brundlefly" searches for a cure to his mutated genes while being monitored by a nefarious corporation that wishes to continue his father's experiments.
